items.title: Cut a flat side first
items.body: Round vegetables roll. Slice once to make a flat side, then dice safely on a stable plane.

items.title: Salt like the sea
items.body: Pasta water should taste briny — about 10 g salt per litre. It seasons the pasta from the inside.

items.title: Five minutes saves the juices
